settings.confirmSend:
Send the log contents to the developer?
** All identifiers will be removed **
settings.logSent:
The log has been sent.
Your reference code is {{hash}}.
Please quote this code when reporting an issue.
settings.logSendFailed:
Failed to send after 5 attempts.
The error messages are at the end of the log.
settings.email: Email Address or Forum id (Required if you want me to respond)
settings.readRegister: First Register Address (use 0x before the number for hex input)
settings.pollingIntervalHint: Minimum is 10 seconds. Lower values update more frequently but can increase network and CPU usage.
settings.connectionModeHint: Automatic finds inverters and selects their connection settings. Manual uses only the devices listed below and follows changes to their IP addresses. Mode changes take effect automatically, without restarting the app.
settings.connectionModeEmpty: Automatic is used because the list is empty. Adding a device switches to Manual.
settings.connectionModeActive: The devices below are in use. Saving an added or edited device switches to Manual; deleting the last device restores Automatic.
settings.connectionModeInactive: The devices below are not in use while Automatic is selected. Select Manual, or save an added or edited device, to use them.
settings.devicesListHint: Adding or editing a device and saving it automatically selects Manual mode.
settings.selectDeviceFirst: Select a device in the list first.
settings.deviceIpRequired: Enter the IP address of the device.
settings.deviceSerialRequired: Enter the logger serial number. It is required for Solarman V5.
